about.title: ABOUT ME
about.bio:
Senior developer specialised in the SAP BTP ecosystem, SAPUI5 / Fiori and CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model), complemented by modern fullstack development in React, Node.js and Cloud Serverless architectures.

I bring a prior track record of more than 10 years leading IT infrastructure, networks and enterprise support, giving me an end-to-end view of architecture, security and business processes that goes well beyond the code.

English level: C1 Advanced (EF SET 68/100) — fluent communication in international settings.

work.summary: Building and extending custom Fiori applications and automating business processes across enterprise SAP ecosystems.
Fullstack development and serverless AWS architecture for the brand and IP protection platform.

highlights.title: PPPI brand protection platform
highlights.detail: Ongoing development and new features. Business logic on AWS Lambda and Serverless, GraphQL schema extensions and DynamoDB persistence, React UI work and CloudFront configuration for content delivery.

work.summary: Design and delivery of SAPUI5 / Fiori solutions, OData service integration and BTP / Cloud Foundry deployments.

highlights.title: S/4HANA and Cloud Foundry migration
highlights.detail: Migrated software assets from SAP ECC to S/4HANA, moving infrastructure from SAP Neo to Cloud Foundry. Refactored SAPUI5 applications for full BTP CF compatibility and defined the access architecture in SAP Build Work Zone: sites, pages, spaces and a role-based security matrix.

highlights.title: Chronological event log
highlights.detail: Unified two business-critical applications into a single architecture with centralised business logic. Orchestration of multiple heterogeneous OData services, a granular security model and dynamic real-time tracking reports.

highlights.title: Shift scheduling and maintenance management
highlights.detail: Intelligent shift assignment for preventive and corrective maintenance. Ordering algorithms driven by operational rules, advanced analytics charts and orchestration of automated task dispatch through SAP Build Process Automation.

highlights.title: Extensibility and automated notifications
highlights.detail: Extended functionality over existing production applications. Advanced Workflow instance management and corporate communication design through dynamic HTML templates for automated backend mail delivery.

work.summary: End-to-end management of networks, servers, technology infrastructure and operations support.
